train: 8526 original train examples excluding all reserved localization workers; gold intent and BIO histories only in training
development: 1504 already consumed original dev examples excluding reserved workers; adaptive selection, not prospective final audit
reservation: Original test and every reserved localizer remain unused; do not evaluate until all development gates justify it
algorithm: Same proportional-int8 averaged perceptron and teacher-forced training as protocol v2. Zero intent_weights retains one-third allocation. Inference remains greedy and receives no labels or teacher queries.
change_hypothesis: Under fixed 20000/24000 stored-weight caps, test allocation between intent and argument heads and hash collisions. First two policies are unchanged controls; this is a bounded hyperparameter experiment, not autonomous seed evolution or a claim of exponential intelligence.
selection: Exact complete dev structures, then fewer stored weights, then policy order; no post-hoc selection of a favorable family
metrics: Exact intent and ordered role/value spans, novelty strata and errors/abstentions in all denominators; report failures even if best candidate improves
scope: Public pt-PT supervision, known algorithm, no pretrained LLM or remote teacher. Margins are not probabilities, certificates or action authority. No M1 promotion from this development sweep alone; unknown energy/RSS remain unavailable.
